response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an experienced and versatile full-stack software engineer with 15+ years of professional work, but his background is almost entirely in web, mobile, and backend application development (Node.js, TypeScript, DLang, Ember, React). The Principal Performance Architect role requires SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, and deep-learning workload optimization — none of which appear in his experience. His closest adjacent work is low-latency microservices at Sociomantic and some C/C++ at National Instruments, which is far removed from silicon-level performance architecture. There is no evidence of SIMD/MIMD, GPU architecture, DNN training/inference optimization, or RTL/model-based hardware work, and no advanced degree in a hardware-related field.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, exceeding the BS + 8 years bar
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Some systems-level C/C++ exposure and strong engineering rigor (TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open source)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack IC, not principal-level silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture expertise
No AI accelerator / DNN performance optimization experience
Deep general software engineering seniority and low-latency systems work
